t.why: A leading member of the Caribbean Community.
t.rel: Large diaspora communities in the United States, Britain and Canada bring remittances and exchanges. A leading member of the Caribbean Community, it works with neighboring islands and takes part in regional issues, such as sending police to Haiti's security crisis.
t.know: It has produced many of the world's great sprinters.
t.etext: Tourism, remittances, and bauxite and alumina, the raw materials for aluminum, are the main sources of income. It has steadily reduced what was once a heavy public debt.
